description: This PHP file defines a global associative array `$combo_strings` containing various lookup lists (dropdown options) used throughout a CRM system, such as account types, industries, lead sources, ticket severities, and more. It also includes external reference to a class `UserTimeZones` to populate a time zone list.

classes.name: UserTimeZones
classes.description: A class loaded from external file `UserTimeZonesArray.php`, responsible for providing an array of user time zones.

methods.name: userTimeZones
methods.description: Method of `UserTimeZones` class that returns an array of supported time zones.
